attack.note: He is an auto attack carry. Give 'Em Some Pepper makes every fourth basic attack hit for 125 percent more with splash, and almost every talent buffs basic attacks. He needs to stutter step between shots.

poke.note: Auto attacks and Penetrating Round are not dodgeable in the normal sense. Penetrating Round is a line that knocks back and slows, and it has a 9 second cooldown.

damage.note: Steady auto damage with a burst on every fourth attack. Healers answer it with normal healing, but Bounty Hunter adds 3 percent of maximum Health and Dusk Wing shreds armor, which beats healing on tanks. Hyperion pushes and zones rather than kills. The measured 2420 hero damage per minute is just above league median and the win rate of 0.447 over 826 games is low, so he is a common but average carry.

good_into.why: Penetrating Round knocks back and slows a line of melee heroes and cancels leaps like Avenging Wrath or Jet Propulsion, which the guide mentions.
Bounty Hunter deals 3 percent of maximum Health and Dusk Wing banshee removes up to 30 Armor, so tanks do not tank him.
Inspire speeds up minions and mercenaries, Exterminator deals 125 percent more to minions, and Hyperion fires Yamato Cannon for 794 at a structure.
Sustained auto damage with Raynor's Raider banshee on one target outlasts a single target healer's mana.
Measured 5.3 merc camps per game, the highest in the set, and Adrenaline Rush with Sustaining Rounds keeps him in lane.

bad_into.why: The guide notes he has no gap closer and lacks any escape except knockback and Adrenaline Rush, which cannot be used at full Health.
Assassins close the gap and kill him inside the 4 second window of one rotation before Penetrating Round comes back.
Stuns stop his stutter step and Adrenaline Rush, and he has Unstoppable only from Raiders Roll at level 20.
A kiter with equal or longer range keeps out of Raynor medium range, and slow Penetrating Round only slows for 2 seconds.
Mobile heroes dodge the line of Penetrating Round and he has no way to follow them.

wants_from_team: Peel and a frontline to protect him while he auto attacks
Crowd control so his slows and Bounty Hunter land consistently
Lane partners so Inspire buffs minions and mercenaries
Map objectives that Hyperion can zone
gives_team: Reliable sustained damage and wave clear
Mercenary camp clears and siege push
Hyperion for objective pressure and Execute Orders for a late revenge
weaknesses: Low win rate in this data
Basic attack reliance makes him easy to kite and burst
evidence: MEASURED block: hero damage 2420 per minute, 5.3 camps per game, win rate 0.447 over 826 games

lens_notes.damage_reach: Guide lists long range as a strength, so long. He has no mobility to use it with if caught.
lens_notes.lane_role: Exterminator makes Inspire autos strong on mercenaries, and measured camps are 5.3 per game. The guide says he should rotate behind the Warriors and not play the offlane.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: No assassin burst. Basic attacks, Penetrating Round and the Banshee wear targets down, and the Banshee chases.
lens_notes.escape: Guide says no innate escape. Raiders Roll at level 20 gives Unstoppable while healing, which is a late talent.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Penetrating Round is a knockback with a slow. It is soft CC and not a stun. Measured enemy CC time is 0.5 seconds per game.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Raynor's Raider is the standard heroic for single target damage and chase. Hyperion is the objective alternative.
lens_notes.power_curve: Steady, with no quest gate; Veteran Marksman and Sergeant Pepper only add a little late.
lens_notes.execution_demand: Guide says low learning curve, but stutter stepping and positioning matter.

lens_gaps: no value on vulnerable_to for blinds, which the guide names as his worst counter because he relies on basic attacks
no value on cc_profile for a knockback that is not a stun, slow or root (Penetrating Round)
